content.text: Hello! How’s it going? What’s up with you?
Lol
How’s the basketball life treating you?
It’s not, I’m still fighting to get the Tigers back. I think I turned the train around but I’m still in limbo
That’s good news! Will you be going down to spring training?
I’m hoping so but probably not until the 28th at the earliest
Are you?
no. I was supposed to help with the shoot, but that got tossed to the wayside I guess
They moved my desk temporarily over to LCA and IU’m sitting with the Olympia creative team until the season starts I guess
Oh wow... what shoot? Why temporarily
We are doing our own stylized shoot with the tigers this year for social and advertising. Usually FSD only does it, but Emily wants everything to be better so social had more money to work with

Idk why temporarily. Emily said it’s only until the start of the season and she just wants me to sit in a creative atmosphere, but I’m just over here still solo working on tigers. Doesn’t make sense. Like if you’re going to merge the creative team, just do it
There’s just no communication
Seems par for the course. So they’re doing like a whole photo shoot thing similar to FSD? And they’re doing it separately? Players gotta be thrilled to go through it twice
Haha I know right. I think they were able to get a separate day so it’s not such a chore
I feel like that’s worse, then they gotta do it again
It’s probably a good idea, though
Yeah. All about that original content now
If you wanna meet up for a drink this week or next, let me know . I”ll be around
That sounds good. Thursday would work for me
That should work for me as well. I can text you that day and we’ll figure it out
Sounds good
